values.welcome_description: Ungalokothi ukhohlwe amakhadi akho obulungu. I-CardOnCue igcina wonke amakhadi akho okutheni endaweni eyodwa ephephile neyangasese.
values.scan_store_description: Sebenzisa ikhamera ukuskena ama-barcode asemakhadini akho angokoqobo, noma uwafake ngesandla. Yonke idatha iyafihlwa futhi igcinwe ngokuphepha kudivayisi yakho.
values.location_aware_description: Uma ufika esitolo, i-CardOnCue izokukhombisa ikhadi lobulungu elifanele ngokuzenzakalelayo. Akukho ukusesha esikhwameni!
values.privacy_first_description: Amakhadi afihlwe endaweni yedivayisi yakho. Idatha yendawo ayigcinwa noma ilandwe. Ulawula idatha yakho ngokuphelele.
values.no_cards_subtitle: Qala ngokuskena ikhadi lakho lokuqala lobulungu
values.scan_camera_description: Qondisa ikhamera kunoma yiliphi i-barcode noma i-QR code
values.enter_manually_description: Thayipha inombolo yekhadi uma ukuskena kungasebenzi
values.secure_private_description: Amakhadi akho afihlwe futhi agcinwe endaweni
values.camera_permission_required: Imvume yekhamera iyadingeka ukuze uskene amakhadi
